item.title: Dear my Sweet Devil II
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Trutima Dokyuun!
  • 発売日: 2011-05-05
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: Dear my Sweet Devil II
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

“Will you always stay in my sunshine?”

I want to say it but I cannot. I want to touch her but I cannot.

All of it that has been given, my standing, my fate… and my crime.

She is the one I love. I want to protect her.

Even if she is the devil…

item.title: Dear my Sweet Devil
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Trutima Dokyuun!
  • 発売日: 2010-12-31
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Dear my Sweet Devil
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

It’s okay. It’s totally okay.

I got up in the morning like always. I went to school like always. I came to the place where she is.

“I’m a devil. I’m…” she says, and our fates are already crossed.

This impossible being, I love her. I am by her always. I want to protect her.
